caption: The drawing depicts a metal coffee pot with an elongated, curved spout on the left side and a large handle on the right. The pot is primarily brown in color, giving it a coppery or rusty appearance. The surface is adorned with a decorative motif: a large, swirling pattern in green, yellow, and red occupying the central area of the pot’s body. This motif features curved lines, small red dots, and yellow highlights. Additional decorative yellow and brown curved lines encircle the top band, base, and lid of the pot. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white, and unadorned, and the name “LELAH NELSON” is written in small text near the lower right side of the image.
title: Toleware Coffee Pot
